{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("customer_age -1 count:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column
print("Revenue sample:", sales['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Check for QA orders
print("QA order count (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded order count:", (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check for conversion rate computation
print("Total orders:", len(sales))
print("Converted orders:", sales['converted'].sum())

# Show unique values in channel and segment
print("Channels:", sales['channel'].unique())
print("Segments:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())"}
